findings.issue: אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא אִתּוֹ is resumptive: the materials were found with the man. Spanish makes the man the one found and él a second male.
H8476 is a common noun; tahashim leaves it untranslated and keeps the Hebrew plural.

notes: Lemma 8336 b licenses lino fino; תּוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי is one material as carmesí.
